subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should #101763 be handled as a hosted Molty deployment/account-state bug, or is there a source-owned OpenClaw UI/gateway path that can still emit label-derived dotted Anthropic ids?
rationale: Current main's normal model picker and sessions.patch path look canonical, but the reporter's hosted evidence shows a live first-run blocker that cannot be debugged from the public checkout alone.

options.title: Inspect hosted Molty payload and state
options.body: A hosted owner should capture the Brain & Keys selection payload, stored workspace/session override, and outgoing provider request, then migrate or redeploy if hosted state is stale.

options.title: Add a source regression if reachable
options.body: If usemolty.com uses this checkout path, add a focused regression preventing display labels or full dotted Anthropic names from becoming provider model ids.

options.title: Route to hosted support boundary
options.body: If the service is outside OpenClaw source ownership, keep this tracked as hosted support and close only after the hosted operator confirms recovery or non-ownership.

recommendation.title: Inspect hosted Molty payload and state
recommendation.body: A hosted owner should capture the Brain & Keys selection payload, stored workspace/session override, and outgoing provider request, then migrate or redeploy if hosted state is stale.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses recent Anthropic catalog support and session model persistence history where steipete has the strongest owner-routing signal.
